描述_EN: using kaolin-rich clays the potters were able to produce cups and bowls that blended in harmoniously with the more expensive silver tableware. this white-glazed bowl was made in north china, where the kilns specialized in high-fired white wares.
描述_ZN: 使用富含高岭土的粘土，陶工们能够生产出与更昂贵的银质餐具和谐地融合在一起的杯子和碗。 这个白釉碗是在中国北方制造的，那里的窑场专门生产高烧的白瓷器。
